idea.title: Loreline – Tools for writing interactive fiction

plan.tagline: Loreline helps writers create interactive fiction with a simple command-line tool
plan.problem: Writing interactive fiction can be cumbersome and disorganized, with multiple story paths and characters to keep track of
plan.solution: Loreline provides a step-by-step solution for writing interactive fiction, including creating and managing story nodes, adding choices and outcomes, generating reports, and receiving alerts for inconsistencies or unfinished storylines
plan.target_market: Indie hackers, developers, and small businesses worldwide who want to create interactive stories, games, or training simulations
mvp_features: Add choices and outcomes to story nodes
Generate reports on story progress and inconsistencies
Receive alerts for unfinished storylines or inconsistencies
Demo mode with sample story and offline functionality

build_phases.name: Core DB + add
build_phases.description: Design sqlite schema and implement add and list commands

build_phases.name: Reports + alerts
build_phases.description: Implement report generation and notification system

build_phases.name: Demo + polish
build_phases.description: Implement --demo mode, --help, and edge case handling

plan.demo_script: The --demo mode shows a sample interactive story with choices and outcomes, demonstrating how to create and manage story nodes, add choices, and generate reports
plan.phuket_angle: Tourism businesses in Phuket can use Loreline to create interactive stories and games for visitors, showcasing the island's history, culture, and attractions
